name: Wrapped Staked NET
reason: Unacceptable collateral exit risk: the observed unwind establishes a route but does not establish executable depth at liquidation size. Mapped NET AMM trades incur a 5% fee, and the documented treasury buyback is capacity-limited and can halt on stale pricing. Deployed wrapper permissions remain unverified. The exclusion is based on exit risk and evidence gaps.
redeem: wsNET is a non-rebasing wrapper of rebasing sNET indexed to staked NET. A successful unwind at Robinhood block 29400787 burned about 0.295 wsNET, returned sNET, unstaked it for NET and sold NET for USDG, incurring a 5% NET transfer tax. NetNet documents a seller-initiated NET buyback at NAV less 1.5%, capped each 8-hour epoch at 1% of liquid treasury reserves and dependent on valid TWAP pricing.
notes: Public RPC confirmed the wrapper's name, symbol and 18 decimals and the unwind receipt on 2026-11-21. The official registry identifies sNET 0xb773ec2c326b7f98a5a83fc098825492f020a4c7 and NET 0xca9c78dd337a67f6e0077f65f5e9218719d30edf. The three ERC-1967 slots were empty and common owner/paused getters reverted; source retrieval was blocked, so mint, pause and alternative upgrade controls remain unverified. NetNet documents a 1-of-1 fee-guardian Safe, treasury exposure to Morpho, and NAV that includes protocol-owned liquidity.
